Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixes reactive held-key attachment without extending event deadlines. Urgent startups may bind the first eligible current key inside their original lease; Purify and Guard bind only at authoritative protection end or inside the original 500-ms window. Expired/disabled leases retire and active leases revalidate exact identity before new packets; a later urgent startup may preempt only an unattempted lower-priority reactive lease. Exact self-target Purify still requires live Resilience; a transient canonical-row miss retries only that signal inside the original 750-ms acquisition deadline. Reachability is checked before ranking; NIN gets a 3-second protection-end lease. Exact SourceSequence attribution prevents manual Miracle, Silent Nocturne, Raiju, Paean, or Aquaveil from claiming automatic success, and durable diagnostics were added. Schema 30 and all existing opt-ins are preserved.
